title: Restoring Lost Virtues
subtitle:
Recovering the divine virtue, glory, and favour
that heaven has assigned to your name.

scriptures.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s. The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed. He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.

Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions. Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin. For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me. Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me. Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me. Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood, And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any, Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched. And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me? And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me. And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately. And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years, And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse, When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment. For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole. And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague. And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes? And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me? And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing. But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth. And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats.
The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams. For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.

And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross.
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.

Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy. A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow. And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them.

declarations: I call my virtues back in the name of Jesus.
I call my breakthroughs back in the name of Jesus.
Whatever the enemy took from me, let it be restored in the name of Jesus.
I am restored. I am blessed. I am restored in the name of Jesus.
My glory is coming back. My favour is coming back. My anointing is coming back. My strength is coming back — in the name of Jesus.
I am blessed and my virtues have been restored.
I am blessed and highly favoured.
I shall be the head and not the tail. I shall be the light of my family.
I will not be empty. I will not be dry. That shall not be my portion.
The Lord will fill my account. The Lord will fill my baskets and my storehouses.
I refuse to remain in this condition. I refuse to accept this fate.
I possess my possessions in the name of Jesus.
By the blood of Jesus every satanic writing, ordinance, and pronouncement against me is blotted out.
The yoke on my neck is broken. I walk in dominion in the name of Jesus.
I receive the oil of gladness in the name of Jesus.
The joy of the Lord is my strength.
My mourning is turned into joy in the name of Jesus.
I am healed. I am delivered. I am covered. My life is secured and preserved through the power of the Holy Ghost.

1. Praise & Worship: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me bless His holy name.
From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, let the name of the Lord be praised in my life today.
I magnify You, Ancient of Days, Rock of Ages, King of kings, Lord of lords, covenant-keeping God.
2. Thanksgiving: Thank You Father for grace, for Your message, and for the gift of life this morning.
Thank You for the eternal blood that is speaking for me, and for Your angelic covering over my life and household.
Thank You that I will not leave this altar the same way I came — blessed, transformed, restored, refreshed.
3. Confession & Mercy: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Your lovingkindness; blot out my transgressions.
Wash me throughly from my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin (Psalm 51).
By the blood of Jesus every accusation of the enemy against me is cancelled — I stand justified.
4. Forgive Others: Father, I forgive everyone who has wronged me, exchanged something from me, or spoken evil over my destiny.
I release them so my prayers will not be hindered and my restoration will not be delayed.
5. Invite the Holy Spirit: Holy Spirit, take pre-eminence over this altar; let the fire of God settle here.
Open my eyes, O Lord, that I may behold wondrous things out of Your law (Psalm 119:18).
Let every word from my mouth be anointed and come by demonstration of the Spirit, not the wisdom of man.
6. Recover Stolen Virtue: Any virtue, glory, or anointing that has left me through sex, food, gifts, friendship, or dreams — I command it back in the name of Jesus.
Every witch, wizard, or spiritual source using my virtue — return what belongs to me sevenfold.
Like the woman with the issue of blood, by faith I touch the hem of His garment and receive virtue from the Master.
Every demonic transaction over my life — every gift, every meal, every covenant that stole from me — I reverse it by the blood of Jesus.
7. Break Yokes & Overturn Satanic Senten: By Colossians 2:14, every handwriting of ordinance, every satanic law and pronouncement against me is blotted out and nailed to the cross.
Any Pharaoh that refuses to let me go — receive the written judgment of the just God.
By Genesis 27:40, when I have the dominion I break every yoke from off my neck in the name of Jesus.
Every stubborn spirit behind my situation — be tamed and finished by the fire of the Holy Ghost.
8. Restoration & Healing: Every fountain of affliction, plague, sickness, delay, and stagnation — dry up now, as at the touch of the Master.
Restore my health, my finances, my marriage, my ministry, my career — as the eagle, renew my youth (Psalm 103:5).
Every glory buried in demonic caves, rivers, forests, mountains, or family altars — release it in Jesus' name.
9. Prosperity & Provision: Blessing of the Lord that maketh rich and addeth no sorrow, rest upon me (Proverbs 10:22).
My God shall supply all my need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19).
I shall lend unto nations and shall not borrow; I am the head and not the tail (Deuteronomy 28:12–13).
10. Joy & Gladness: By Psalm 45:7, anoint me afresh with the oil of gladness above my fellows.
By John 16:20, turn my sorrow into joy; let my joy be full.
The joy of the Lord is my strength — every tormentor of my mind, be silenced.
11. Sealing with the Blood: I seal every prayer, declaration, and impartation with the blood of Jesus.
Let the blood cover my life, my family, my finances, my ministry, my movements and my dreams.
Every demon assigned to reverse this altar — be scattered by the blood of Jesus.

directions.title: Fasting
directions.body: 21-day fast beginning Monday. Fast Monday to Friday each week; eat on weekends and resume on Monday. Keep to your normal prayer time. In the closing seven days Prophet Prince and Woman of God Pastor Kiky lead a consistent morning and evening prayer.

directions.title: Anointing oil
directions.body: Take your anointing oil during the teaching. Pray over it and anoint yourself as declarations are released — marking yourself with the blood and the oil for a turnaround.

directions.title: Saturday deliverance service
directions.body: Meet on Saturday for the Deliverance Service with Prophet Prince and Woman of God Pastor Kiky. 12:00 midnight BST · 11:00 PM GMT · 7:00 PM EST · 6:00 PM CST · 5:00 PM MST · 4:00 PM PST.

directions.title: Clubhouse schedule
directions.body: Live on Clubhouse — Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday at 8:00 AM EST / 1:00 PM GMT. Come with an open heart; the 8:30–9:00 AM window is preparation, expectation, Scripture and prayer.

directions.title: WhatsApp scriptures
directions.body: Scriptures will be sent through the WhatsApp platform during the fast — meditate on them daily.

directions.title: Almsgiving with discernment
directions.body: Bless orphanages and the poor with a pure heart. Refuse gifts, meals, or transactions given with a hidden intention to exchange your virtue. If a gift is contaminated, return it or lay it before the Lord.

directions.title: Sowing & tithing
directions.body: Give your tithe as a covering over the 90 percent; give as the Lord leads with faith, not for show. Vain glory and love of money must not touch the servant of God.

directions.title: Guard your senses
directions.body: Do not eat the bread of him that hath an evil eye (Proverbs 23:6). Discern before you eat, before you sleep with anyone, before you accept a gift, and before you receive counsel.

directions.title: Live in the Word
directions.body: Read Psalm 103, Psalm 51, Psalm 119:18, Mark 5:25–34 and Luke 8:43–48 daily through this season. Faith comes by hearing the word — refined through anointed vessels.
